top_signals.title: Senior US general fired, accused of leaking classified information
top_signals.summary: U.S. Army Lt. Gen. Brett Sylvia, a senior military planner on the Pentagon's Joint Staff, was fired over accusations he leaked classified information to the public.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
